messages:
maria: quick heads-up — noticing chat endpoints returning 200 for requests authenticated with tokens that only have `embeddings:write` scope. started ~03:10 UTC after last night's RBAC rollout.
sec-bot: [ALERT] 2026-02-10T03:12:45Z scope_fallback detected on /v1/chat.generate (count=128)
jamie: confirmed in logs, example entry: `scope_override=true, original_scopes=["embeddings:write"], effective_scopes=["chat:write"]`
alex: can you paste a minimal repro? want to validate whether it's a routing fallback or middleware enforcement bug
maria: repro below (sanitized):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_rotated_example" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
```
response: 200 with chat tokens emitted.
jamie: token introspect for that key shows: `{"sub":"svc-emb-01","scopes":["embeddings:write"],"kid":"kms-key-5"}`
devin: digging: RBAC v2 middleware introduced `applyRouteDefaults()` that merges route default scopes when token.scopes is empty. bug: it treats missing scopes as empty and then merges, effectively granting route defaults instead of rejecting.
alex: ah — so when KMS rotation briefly returned tokens w/ missing scope claim (introspect returned null for scopes), the middleware defaulted to route scopes. explains correlation w/ key roll.
oncall: impact assessment: ~1.2k requests matched fallback window (03:10-03:20 UTC). mostly low-risk dev keys but a handful of prod SDK keys.
maria: immediate mitigation suggestions?
jamie: 1) hotfix enforcement to treat missing scopes as deny (stop-gap) 2) revoke affected tokens (rotate) 3) backfill audit log entries marking scope_fallback=true for customer notifications 4) patch KMS rotation path so introspect never returns null scopes.
alex: I can cut a small patch to enforcement middleware: change `effectiveScopes = token.scopes || route.defaults` to `if (!token.scopes) reject()` and return 401. will open PR. :thumbsup:
devin: also found audit entries with `event:scope_fallback, actor:kms-service, kid:kms-key-5` — suggests introspect service returned an incomplete token during rotation window.
sec-bot: [INFO] raised incident INC-2026-0210 and created postmortem draft.
oncall: operational steps:
- rotate/revoke affected keys (maria + infra)
- deploy enforcement hotfix to prod (alex)
- run a targeted audit query for any writes to chat/llm endpoints from tokens with embeddings-only scope (jamie)
- notify customers for any keys in their orgs (security comms)
maria: I started a KMS revoke for `svc-emb-01` and added it to denylist. leaving note for infra to confirm revocation propagated to regional caches.
jamie: looking at logs: 6 distinct customer orgs touched, two have production usage. we should prepare an email template.
devin: long-term fix: change token introspect to return explicit empty-scopes array and add schema validation on token issuance so scopes are never omitted; also add unit tests for scope enforcement across all route types (chat/embeddings/rerank).
alex: PR #4827 created: enforcement hotfix + a feature flag (rbac_strict_missing_scopes). will request expedited review.
maria: for customer comms we need timeline + action items + whether any data exposure occurred. interim assessment: only inference requests (no access to stored user data).
oncall: recommend 4-hour maintenance window to rotate any shared SDK keys and push hotfix.
jamie: audit query snippet (internal):
```
SELECT timestamp, kid, token_sub, route, original_scopes, effective_scopes
FROM audit.events
WHERE event_type = 'scope_evaluation' AND effective_scopes != original_scopes
AND timestamp >= '2026-02-10T03:00:00Z' AND timestamp <= '2026-02-10T03:30:00Z';
```
maria: assigning tasks: @alex implement hotfix; @jamie run audits and assemble customer list; @devin follow up KMS rotation behavior; I'll own communications and revocation.
alex: on it, will ping when PR is merged and deployed.
jamie: will produce CSV of affected tokens + org ids by EOD.
devin: filing KMS ticket to prevent null-scope introspects, will link to this thread.
maria: if anyone notices regression after hotfix (false denies), drop a message here and we'll toggle feature flag.
sec-bot: [RESOLVE] scope_fallback closed after hotfix deploy 2026-02-10T04:12:07Z.
oncall: postmortem owners: maria, devin, jamie. will do severity review tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
